intelligence.human_view: Think of the old calendar as a desk with a calendar on it and a pile of buttons next to it — you had to look at everything at once, and nothing felt like the calendar itself. Shawn swept the desk clean. Now the whole desk IS the calendar: the full month fills the whole screen, mobile or laptop, and nothing else is on it. You tap a date and the whole screen becomes that day — its menu, its world — and when you tap back, you're back at the month, exactly where you were. The menu isn't a strip of flat buttons beside the month; it's a whole new view, built high-level, with eight doors and the things that matter that day. And the prototype he uploaded already works that way — the round's job is to harvest it verbatim and make it real and high-level, not to design a new calendar from scratch.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your whole screen is just the calendar — big squares for every day, 1 to 30, nothing else! No buttons, no words, just the month! You tap a day and BOOM — the whole screen becomes that day, with all its fun doors to open! And when you tap back, you're right back at the month! The calendar isn't a little box on a page — the calendar IS the page!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine the whole screen is just the calendar, dear — the full month, big beautiful squares for every day, and nothing else on the page at all! No clutter, no buttons getting in the way! You tap a day and the whole screen becomes that day, love — its menu, everything going on! And you tap back and you're right back at the month! Simple as anything, dear — the calendar is the whole page, and the day is the door!
intelligence.naya_view: The whole page IS the calendar: full month, squares 1–30/31, nothing else on it. No buttons on the same page as the calendar; the menu comes only when they click a date, as a new full view — 8 doors + Book/Meet/Create + 3 cards. Way more high-level than flat buttons. Harvest Shawn's prototype verbatim as the base. Vertical slice first, then verified booking, then verified Meet. Old round's shape superseded; its booking/meet/data logic is harvest material only.
